title: Bole Penthouse Living Lounge
description: An airy high-floor penthouse renovation in the heart of Bole. The objective was to create a restful, sculptural salon bathed in natural morning light. We paired neutral oatmeal Belgian linen seating with honed travertine and brass elements, balancing organic warmth with urban sophistication.
clientBrief: Client sought an unhurried, minimalist sanctuary for evening entertaining that complements floor-to-ceiling city views without competing with them.

title: Old Airport Diplomatic Villa Dining
description: Commissioned for an ambassadorial residence in Old Airport. The space centers on an expansive 8-seat solid teak dining table, illuminated by custom low-hung brass pendants, flanked by textured walnut counter seating overlooking the garden.
clientBrief: Formal diplomatic hospitality combined with warm family breakfast functionality.

title: Kazanchis Tech Studio Headquarters
description: A collaborative workspace engineered for creative productivity. Solid timber meeting benches paired with ergonomic task chairs, integrated acoustic wall cladding, and open modular shelving.
clientBrief: Fostering deep-work focus while keeping client reception zones open, cultured, and polished.

title: CMC Modern Master Sanctuary
description: A calm, clutter-free bedroom in a contemporary CMC residential tower. Featuring a floating walnut platform bed frame, floor-to-ceiling fluted oak wardrobes, and soft ambient perimeter lighting.
clientBrief: A boutique hotel feel at home, maximizing storage without visual clutter.

title: Sarbet Terrace Garden Residence
description: Seamless indoor-outdoor living designed for sunny Addis Ababa afternoons. Teak lounge seating wrapped in resilient Sunbrella textiles with native highland flora accents.
clientBrief: Weather-resistant outdoor space suitable for both quiet weekend reading and lively family gatherings.

title: Entoto Hills Forest Villa
description: Nestled near eucalyptus groves, this modern stone-and-timber retreat showcases custom oak cabinetry, low-slung leather armchairs, and a custom media console with woven cane accents.
clientBrief: Organic textures that reflect the surrounding nature and create a cozy mountain-chalet warmth.
